v1.2.0 - what TDOT opens
Same form, same grey cells, same Alternative Setup button. What is new is the guidance around them.
The Summary is where the answer lives: present worth by category, the RealCost-style agency / user / total block, and five charts. The lowest-cost row highlights itself.
Every alternative worksheet gets a way back to the form and the Summary. Typical Values is a new reference sheet: workbook defaults beside recent bid prices, a source on every row.

v1.1.2 - what it looks like today
No guidance on the form, and a Summary of five columns and one chart.
